backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the Maa Bhawani General Store backend, defining state and endpoints for user profiles, products, orders, recharge orders, carts, bills, shop settings (UPI ID, slogan, open/closed status), and access control via admin/user permissions.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented UI features (button color fixes, header visibility, category filter styling, etc.) to their affected frontend files, component dependencies, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Auto-generated JSON summaries describing the purpose and key changes of each frontend source file, serving as a build planning reference for the React frontend.
frontend/index.css: Global CSS entry point that imports Tailwind layers and defines CSS custom properties for the light and dark theme color tokens used throughout the app.
frontend/index.html: HTML shell for the React PWA, configuring viewport, theme color, PWA meta tags, Apple touch icons, Google Fonts (Inter), and the app manifest for Maa Bhawani General Store.
frontend/public/manifest.json: PWA web app manifest defining the app name, display mode, theme/background colors, and icon references for Maa Bhawani General Store.
frontend/public/service-worker.js: Service worker implementing a cache-first strategy for static assets and a network-first strategy for API/canister calls, with install-time pre-caching and old cache cleanup on activation.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React app component that defines all client-side routes using TanStack Router, including home, checkout, order confirmation, store details, admin, billing, settings, search, my-orders, and wallet pages.
frontend/src/components/AdminGuard.tsx: A route guard component that restricts access to admin-only pages by verifying a hardcoded Admin ID/password with a 24-hour localStorage session, and also checks the caller's on-chain admin status via Internet Identity.
frontend/src/components/AdminProductForm: A form component for adding new products to the store, supporting fields like name, category, price, unit type, barcode (with scanner), stock quantity, and image upload with progress tracking.
frontend/src/components/AdminProductList: Displays a table of all products with inline stock editing, low-stock warnings, and the ability to remove products, using React Query hooks for data fetching and mutations.
frontend/src/components/BarcodeScanner.t: A camera-based barcode scanner component that dynamically loads the Quagga2 library from CDN, supports torch/flash toggling, scan cooldown, haptic feedback, and beep audio on successful scan.
frontend/src/components/BillHistoryTable: Renders a searchable, filterable table of billing history with options to view or print individual bills in a dialog and export the filtered list as a CSV file.
frontend/src/components/BillTemplate.tsx: Renders a printable bill template for Maa Bhawani General Store, including itemized order details, delivery charge logic, UPI QR code generation, and a WhatsApp share button.
frontend/src/components/BottomNavBar.tsx: Fixed bottom navigation bar with four links (Home, Search, My Orders, Wallet) that highlights the active route using TanStack Router.
frontend/src/components/CallUsButton.tsx: Floating action button fixed to the bottom-right corner that initiates a phone call to the store's number.
frontend/src/components/CartDrawer.tsx: Slide-in cart drawer showing cart items, subtotal, delivery fee, and a checkout button; disables checkout when the shop is closed.
frontend/src/components/CategoryFilter.t: Horizontally scrollable list of category filter buttons that highlights the currently selected category.
Static informational alert component that displays the store's delivery fee policy.
frontend/src/components/ErrorBoundary.ts: React class-based error boundary that catches render errors and displays an error message with stack trace details and reset/home buttons.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Site footer displaying store name, contact info, Google Maps link, delivery info, and a copyright notice with a caffeine.ai attribution link.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Sticky top header with store logo, shop open/closed indicator, admin dashboard link, cart icon with item count badge, and login/logout button using Internet Identity.
frontend/src/components/HeroBannerCarous: Auto-advancing carousel component displaying three promotional store banners with navigation arrows, dot indicators, and a 4-second auto-play interval.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout wrapper that renders Header, Footer, and conditional BottomNavBar/WhatsAppHelpButton for non-admin routes, while prefetching shop status.
frontend/src/components/MobileRechargeSe: Compact card showing operator icons (Airtel, Jio, Vi, BSNL, MTNL) that opens a dialog form for submitting mobile recharge orders via a mutation hook.
frontend/src/components/PaymentQRCode.ts: Displays a UPI payment QR code image alongside the order amount and step-by-step payment instructions for completing a transaction.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: Card component for a single product showing its image, name, price, unit, a quantity selector, and an Add to Cart button that is disabled when the shop is closed.
frontend/src/components/ProductGrid.tsx: Renders a responsive 2-column grid of ProductCards filtered by category, with skeleton loading states and an empty-state illustration.
frontend/src/components/ShopClosedBanner: Displays a red warning banner with opening hours only when the shop status has been fetched and confirmed as closed.
frontend/src/components/ShopClosedChecko: Alert dialog that automatically appears when the shop transitions from open to closed, or when externally triggered, redirecting the user to the home page on dismissal.
frontend/src/components/ShopStatusToggle: Admin toggle switch that reads and optimistically updates the shop open/closed status via query hooks, reverting on error.
frontend/src/components/WhatsAppHelpButt: Fixed floating button that opens a pre-filled WhatsApp chat link to the store's phone number.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, supporting both anonymous and authenticated (Internet Identity) usage, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an InternetIdentityProvider component and useInternetIdentity hook for managing ICP Internet Identity authentication state, including login, logout, and identity persistence via AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Centralizes all React Query hooks (queries and mutations) for interacting with the backend actor, covering products, cart, bills, orders, and other store operations.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that sets up Tailwind CSS, defines OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark themes, and includes utility styles for touch, print, and barcode scanner animations.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin dashboard page with tabbed navigation for managing orders, products, bills, and settings, including stat cards, batch delivery grouping, and order status filtering.
frontend/src/pages/AdminSettingsPage.tsx: Admin settings page allowing store administrators to update the shop slogan, configure a UPI ID for payment QR codes, and perform an emergency shop close action.
frontend/src/pages/BillingPage.tsx: In-store billing page that allows adding products to a cart via search or barcode scan, entering customer details, and generating a printable bill using the useGenerateBill mutation.
frontend/src/pages/CheckoutPage.tsx: Checkout form page that collects delivery details and payment method, calculates totals with a conditional delivery fee, and places an order via the usePlaceOrder mutation, blocking submission if the shop is closed.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Main storefront page composing a hero banner carousel, shop-closed banner, category filter, product grid, and mobile recharge section.
frontend/src/pages/MyOrdersPage.tsx: Placeholder page for order history that displays a coming-soon message with a shopping bag icon.
frontend/src/pages/OrderConfirmationPage: Order confirmation page that shows the order ID, payment method, and either a UPI QR code or a cash-on-delivery notice, reading order totals from sessionStorage.
frontend/src/pages/SearchPage.tsx: Placeholder page for product search that displays a coming-soon message with a search icon.
frontend/src/pages/StoreDetailsPage.tsx: Static store information page displaying contact number, location link, delivery policy, hours, services list, and an embedded Google Maps iframe.
frontend/src/pages/WalletPage.tsx: Placeholder page for wallet functionality that displays a coming-soon message with a wallet icon.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module providing functions to read, persist, and clear URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage fallback for sensitive values like admin tokens.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration for the frontend, extending the theme with oklch-based CSS variable colors, custom border radii, Inter font family, box shadows, accordion keyframes, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state document (version 3) describing an e-commerce/recharge web app with an admin panel, cataloguing known UI bugs (invisible white-on-white buttons), existing features being implemented to fix button visibility with #0056b3 styling, and architectural notes about admin panel sync and invoice features.
